title: Outreach: 28 emails drafted in Silvio's Gmail, waiting for Dinis's yes on the claims before Silvio sends
detail: Silvio's highlight: 28 companies chosen and 28 personal emails drafted in his mailbox overnight (5 Portuguese ones in Portuguese, WS-25; the 23 other 'meet' companies in English, WS-26). Nothing sent: Silvio sends. Each asks for 20 minutes at our stand on Thursday 12 November, between Booths A1-30. 19 have a public address from the company's own site; 9 have only a web form. Replies are checked every 2 hours. Silvio's conductor's plan (people/silvio/outreach/README.md) asks that Dinis approve the claims about RiskMandate before the first email goes, and that every email offer a 'no thanks' and say where the address was found: the drafts get those two lines before sending. Nimay, Indi: say if any of these companies is already yours, so nobody writes twice. Next: 22 more from the buyers list (people/silvio/outreach/buyers.json).
recommend: Approve today: the drafts use only the line already on the meet pages (reach, mandate, gap, barriers) and make no promise about price, the stand or the organisers.
options: Dinis approves the claims as drafted; Silvio starts sending today, 25 to 30 a day
Dinis changes the claims first; the outreach agent updates the 28 drafts
